paper.title_en: DIS dipole picture cross section at finite energy
paper.abstract_en: We implement a finite-energy constraint in the dipole picture of deep inelastic scattering, by restricting the invariant mass of the produced partonic system by the virtual photon-target center of mass energy. We show that, for <math display="inline"><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>Q</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><msup><mrow><mi>GeV</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></math>, the effect of this constraint can reach up to <math display="inline"><mo>∼</mo><mn>35</mn><mo>%</mo></math> for charm quarks and <math display="inline"><mo>∼</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>%</mo></math> for light quarks at <math display="inline"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0.01</mn></math> but then rapidly decreases at smaller <math display="inline"><mi>x</mi></math> or larger <math display="inline"><msup><mi>Q</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math>.
